site.name: המשך תנועה
site.description: המשך תנועה is an Israeli nonprofit building a nationwide network of local community centers, with regular activities for combat veterans after their service: room to meet, move, find direction and build a good life.

cta.aria: Sign up for a meeting: upcoming meetings

footer.about: המשך תנועה is a home for combat veterans after their service: regular meetings built on movement, community and direction — and, on the way, local community centers across Israel.

photos.training: A group of men and women training outdoors on a hillside above a city. Some lift kettlebells, others work with resistance bands, while a coach explains something to one of them.
photos.running: Three people, a woman and two men, running together on a dirt trail among pine trees, in low sunlight.
photos.talk: A group seated around a long wooden table with coffee mugs and notebooks, listening to a woman who stands and speaks. Behind them, a large window looks out onto a street.
photos.bonfire: Men and women sitting around a campfire on a hillside at dusk, holding mugs and laughing.
photos.walk: Two young men walking and talking on a path under eucalyptus trees, both smiling. One wears a uniform; the other a T-shirt and jeans, with a backpack.
photos.hills: A dirt path winding down between olive trees toward rolling hills, in low sunlight.
